summary: Crowd character idling at the end of a detour (lower-city crowds seen during the Shadow-cursed / morgue fights in SCL_Main_A; born alone). Written and counted by esv::crowds::DetourSystem::Update.

fields.name: Duration
fields.evidence: esv::crowds::DetourSystem::Update (macOS bg3_macos_x64+0x5F0E5C0; Windows EoCServer.dll+0xD99D20) adds the component when the crowd member reached its detour target, zeroes 8 bytes and stores at +0 a random value between the CrowdCharacterTrigger's floats +0xA8 and +0xAC (min/max idle time). Live 5.9..9.5.

fields.name: Elapsed
fields.evidence: Same Update adds GetDeltaTimeForEntity to +4 each frame and ends idling when Duration <= Elapsed. Live 0..1.22.

open_questions: Offsets read from the macOS Update only; live data fits (Windows Update delegates to unnamed helpers).
